title: loranthus wallichianus
intro: Loranthus wallichianus, commonly known as the Indian mistletoe or Rajani, is a parasitic plant species belonging to the Loranthaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Loranthus wallichianus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties.
